_comment: Map catalog. Each map is a 2D grid of tile_id integers that reference the Tile Palette (map_tiles.json) for visual + behavioral properties (walkable, sprite, default interaction type). Per-cell instance data — destination of a portal cell, items placed by the author on a cell — lives in the sparse `links` and `tile_items` arrays so a generic tile type can be reused across maps without conflict. `tags` group maps in the editor for organization; the linking system is independent of tags. The grid is row-major: grid[row][col].

maps.name: Town Square
maps.description: The cobbled square at the heart of Town One — a stone path crosses east to west, grass on either side. Placeholder map used to seed the editor; replace with real geometry as it gets painted.
